title: Kazuhiko Yamashita
vital_facts: Baptized as a young adult; Priesthood shortly thereafter
Married Tazuko Tashiro, 1980, Tokyo, Japan (Sealed, Tokyo Japan Temple after its dedication later in 1980); six children
Bachelor's in Education, Saitama University; Master's in Sports Science, Tsukuba University
Assistant Professor, Tsukuba University; Professor, Fukuoka University
Stake Mission President; Bishop; High Councilor; Stake President; Area Seventy
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
